{{Top|ca|leg}}
[[Dams Denna/Legends|Dams Denna]], a resident of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during its [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|victory]] celebration over the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|183|Denna, Dams}}</ref> was a collector of '''Linn'con''' memorabilia.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Dams Denna}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Linn'con memorabilia was introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Canon|lore]] through the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Images-HT/starwars/TheedPalace-Light/large/damsdenna.gif "Dams Denna" card] from the [[2001]] ''[[Theed Palace Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], which commemorates the cameo appearance of [[Dan Madsen]] in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="CCG" /> Madsen, then the president of [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|The Official ''Star Wars'' Fan Club]] and publisher of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|48|I Was an Episode I Easter Egg!}}</ref> collects memorabilia related to [[Wikipedia:Abraham Lincoln|Abraham Lincoln]],<ref name="Star Hustlers">{{WebCite|url=https://www.westword.com/news/star-hustlers-5059622|text=Star Hustlers|author=LaMorte, Chris|date=1999-03-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Westword|''Westword'']]|quote=[&hellip;] today [Madsen] collects Abraham Lincoln and Mark Twain memorabilia.|archivedate=20200811235501}}</ref> the sixteenth [[Wikipedia:President of the United States|president of the United States]].<ref name="White House">{{WebCite|url=https://www.whitehouse.gov/about-the-white-house/presidents/abraham-lincoln|text=Abraham Lincoln|author=Frank Freidel and Hugh Sidey|work=[[Wikipedia:whitehouse.gov|whitehouse.gov]]|archivedate=20200810060713}}</ref>
